subject: Fix assumptions that pthread functions set errno (#2526)
reason: The change only corrects the error string logged when pthread_create or pthread_sigmask fails (using the returned error code instead of errno). Control flow is unchanged: pthread_create failure still exits(1), pthread_sigmask failure still only logs a warning. These failure paths fire only when the OS cannot create a thread or mask a signal at startup, which cannot be triggered by commands, faults, replication, persistence or the bundled tools, and the only observable difference is log message text on an otherwise-fatal path. No scenario can reach or validate this change.
